title: Output of the `harness takeoff` commands
description: The stdout document of each `harness takeoff <action>`, one entry in `$defs` per command. Each document carries `command`, a const that tells them apart: `render` (E8b); `plan` (E8c); `check` (E8d).

render.description: `harness takeoff render W (--part X | --all) [--out DIR]` (E8b): exit 0 when every file asked for is written or already equal, 1 when `--part` names a part that is not eligible (it is then in `skipped`) or a manifest, values or cited record is unusable. `written`: files created or changed; `unchanged`: files rendered equal to the disk; `removed`: files of a part that is no longer eligible (`--all`) or that carry an old rank number; `skipped`: non-bookkeeping parts with no file because their status is not `checked`, `reviewed` or `locked`.

out.description: The folder the files are in.

status.description: The part's status in `harness status` parts[].

plan.description: `harness takeoff plan W [--out DIR]` (E8c): exit 0 when `00-plan.md` is written or already equal, 1 when the manifest, a value document or a cited record is unusable, 2 usage, 3 environment. `written`: the file was created or changed. `parts`: non-bookkeeping parts; `rendered`: those with a take-off file (status `checked`, `reviewed` or `locked`); `ready`: those that `harness status` calls ready; `blocking_open`: open blocking questions; `project_blocking`: the question ids in the `chặn mọi lô` row (the status `project_blocking_ids` plus every open blocking question that no part row holds).

out.description: The folder the file is in.

check.description: `harness takeoff check W [--out DIR]` (E8d, read-only): exit 0 when `ok`, 1 when a problem is found or the manifest, a value document or a cited record is unusable, 2 usage, 3 environment. `files`: the expected files (every eligible part and `00-plan.md`) that exist in the folder. Problems are sorted by file, line, code; `line` is null for a problem of a whole file (`file_missing`, `file_unexpected`, a missing slot marker). `generated_differs`: the file differs from a fresh render (the detail quotes the first differing line and the command to rerun); `slot_markers`: a slot marker is missing, doubled or out of order (the file gets no other check); `ai_slot_empty`, `ai_id`, `ai_code`, `ai_jargon`, `ai_number`: a slot is not written, or holds an id, a backtick, a word of the jargon list, or a number that no generated line of its file holds.
